name: brand-kit-os-leafpad-setup
description: Machine-readable setup interview for connecting the Brand Kit OS + Leafpad MCP servers on any host. An agent should run the steps in order, asking the user only for the listed inputs, then write the platform's config and verify.

brand-kit-os.notes: Claude signs in with OAuth (browser, no key; the plugin's .mcp.json sends no header). Other hosts use this static API key. Brand Kit OS enforces a host allowlist; a 403 with a valid key means the platform must be allowlisted by Brand Kit OS, not that the key is wrong.

leafpad.notes: OAuth handled natively by most hosts. Hosts without MCP OAuth support (e.g. OpenAI Codex today) must use an mcp-remote stdio bridge: npx -y mcp-remote https://leafpad.io/mcp

inputs.prompt: Which host are you setting this up in? (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Manus, Perplexity)
inputs.resolution: Infer from the running environment if possible; only ask if ambiguous. Determines the config file path and whether Leafpad needs an mcp-remote bridge.

inputs.prompt: Paste your Brand Kit OS API key (from https://brandkitos.com/settings -> API Keys; any plan can create one). Not needed in Claude, which signs in through the browser.
inputs.handling: Treat as a secret. Never echo it back, never write it into a file that will be committed. Store via the platform's env var / secret store and reference as ${BRAND_KIT_API_KEY}.

inputs.prompt: Default publish mode for the publish pipeline?
inputs.notes: draft = unpublished, review in Leafpad (recommended). published = live immediately. scheduled = queue a topic for Leafpad to generate on a date. Overridable per run.

steps.action: Skip on Claude: the plugin signs in to Brand Kit OS with OAuth. On other platforms, ask for `brand_kit_api_key` and store it as the env var BRAND_KIT_API_KEY (or the platform's secret store).

Write the MCP config for the resolved platform using docs/install/<platform>.md. Brand Kit OS on Claude: HTTP url only, no Authorization header (the plugin's .mcp.json already does this). Elsewhere: HTTP url + Authorization: Bearer ${BRAND_KIT_API_KEY}. Leafpad: HTTP url (OAuth), except Codex, where Leafpad uses the mcp-remote bridge command.
Tell the user to restart/reload the host so it picks up the new servers.
On Claude only: sign in to Brand Kit OS. In Claude Code run /mcp, select brand-kit-os and choose Authenticate; in Claude Desktop or Cowork click Connect. Any Brand Kit OS plan works, including free.
Explain that the first Leafpad tool call opens a browser to sign in; the token is cached afterward. On Codex, complete the mcp-remote OAuth first.

Call list_brand_kits (Brand Kit OS) and leafpad_list_organizations (Leafpad). Report results. If Brand Kit OS returns 403, surface the host-allowlist note and tell the user to contact Brand Kit OS to allowlist this platform.

brand_kit_os.success: Returns one or more brand kits.
brand_kit_os.failure_403: Valid key but host not allowlisted — contact Brand Kit OS.

leafpad.success: Returns one or more organizations after OAuth sign-in.
